observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 205.» (L7) and «p. 206.» (L33) in the left margin. In «p. 205.» the 2 is printed broken, like £, and the 5 blotted; read as 205 between «p. 204» (p. 135) and «p. 206.» (L33).
body L29: the o of «quo» before «altitudinem» is printed with a tail at its right foot, like α; read as quo.
body L30: the t of «sciothericum» is printed broken, like an exclamation mark.

body L31, L32, L33: a speck is joined to the foot of the second i of «altitudinis» (L31); a speck stands before «aequaverit» (L32), at the height of the tops of the letters; a speck stands over the u of «altitudinis» (L33). They are not signs or accents.
notes_left L5: a speck stands over the u of «doute»; it is not an accent.
notes_right L4: the t of «debent» is printed broken.
body L15: a speck stands between «undecimae» and «in», at the height of a hyphen; it is not a sign.
notes_left L1, L4: the closing parenthesis of «(1)» is printed broken; the c of «declinat.» is printed broken and the point is joined to the t.
notes_right L5: the dash between the verses «139-145» is a hyphen (3.5 pt).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
